facts.summary: MacBaram requires an Apple M-series chip (M1 or later) and macOS 13 or later. MacBook Neo with A18 Pro is not currently supported.
User-defined fan curves and fan control are available when the Mac reports a verified controllable-fan capability.
Charging-related limits are available on supported portable Macs.
Sleep prevention is available for long-running work on supported Macs.

After a brief adapter-disconnect grace period, MacBaram can stop Stay Awake and Virtual Clamshell at the user-selected low-battery threshold, return supported fan, charging, and sleep behavior toward macOS defaults, and allow normal sleep to occur. Saved choices can be considered again after external power returns or the battery recovers, but only when the current authorization still allows them.

On supported fan-equipped MacBooks, Heat Protection can coordinate a charging pause and an available fan response from the same battery-temperature condition, then restore the active fan policy after cooling.

Virtual Clamshell is available on supported M-series MacBooks: the built-in physical display can turn off while a software virtual screen maintains an already authorized lid-closed session without a real external monitor.
Air, Desktop, and Pro are the current individual plan families; commercial availability and exact terms remain canonical on the official website.

Baram means wind in Korean; the name preserves MacBaram's identity as a product made in Korea and its interest in Mac heat and airflow, without claiming technical superiority, safety, or guaranteed results.

For an eligible first-time user, the five-day evaluation period starts with MacBaram's first successful license check after Google sign-in; opening sign-in or clicking a button does not start it, and available features follow the effective plan in the validated signed license.

Normal purchase uses Creem-confirmed paid access without a complimentary code. A complimentary code creates one account-bound access grant for its selected plan and period. Supporter complimentary access, Creator Access, and a Supporter recommendation connection remain distinct; the recommendation connection identifies a later eligible paid purchase only and is not product access, a discount, or an access-code redemption.

Creator Sponsorship applications are open for creators with public activity: applicants provide a public activity URL, their Mac and Apple chip, the requested Air, Desktop, or Pro plan, and the intended use; approved applicants receive one 365-day access code without any required review, positive rating, purchase, or product feedback, and MacBaram does not interfere with the content or conclusion of a review a creator chooses to publish.
Supporters is separate from Creator Sponsorship; referral tracking and payout are not guaranteed until the full operating flow is verified end to end.
On supported portable Macs, Power-Only can keep operation primarily on external power after the selected charging target is reached and the current hardware and power state allow it.
On supported portable Macs, Safety Drain can use the Mac's normal system load to return a battery above its selected target toward that target before resuming the selected charging policy.
MacBaram coordinates supported fan, battery, power, display, and sleep controls as one operating state rather than presenting them only as unrelated utilities.

MacBaram manages supported Mac operating conditions around long-running work such as local AI, builds and tests, photo processing, video and 3D rendering, backups, large downloads, automation, and already-connected remote sessions; it does not operate those workload applications themselves.
On supported fan-equipped Macs, fan curves use measured temperature feedback instead of assuming that one fixed command remains appropriate as conditions change.

MacBaram keeps a control unavailable or returns supported behavior toward macOS defaults when required public-safe hardware, temperature, power, or session conditions are not satisfied. An authorization-related return is complete only after the supported state is verified; affected optional controls remain unavailable while that return is incomplete, and a pending entitlement-restriction return can make another supported attempt. Repository evidence does not establish the installed release's physical outcome, which requires separate installation and device-state readback evidence.
Current Air, Desktop, and Pro plans do not automatically detect Ollama or switch settings by workload; workload-aware assistance belongs to the Enterprise Single roadmap.
Enterprise Single is a future single-Mac direction and is not a currently available product plan.
Enterprise Fleet is a future organization-level multi-Mac direction and is not a currently available product plan.
Fan, battery, power, and sleep state are presented in one dashboard.
Intel Macs are not supported.
iMac support is not currently declared; affected controls remain unavailable when required capability is not verified.
